bugs.expected: After a click in the timeline, the edit context is the timeline: Delete/Backspace delete the selected clip (SRW-24), the same as after a fader (C-R32-01 fix).
bugs.actual: Focus stays in the search field. Delete does nothing to the clip, and Backspace silently edits the hidden search text ('ab' -> 'a'), so the library filter changes. No status is shown. This is pre-existing behaviour, out of round 33's scope (record only, B observation confirmed). It is not a round-33 failure. Related record: typed Clip Gain '3' without Enter is silently discarded when another clip is clicked (focus goes to BODY, no entry).
